PitchProof

PitchProof is website audit report software for agencies, freelancers, SEO teams, and web design teams.

The product helps agencies scan prospect websites and turn the findings into client-ready website assessment reports for outreach, discovery calls, proposals, and follow-up.

Primary audience:
- Web design agencies
- Marketing agencies
- SEO agencies
- Freelance web designers
- Digital consultants

Core pages:
- Homepage: https://pitchproof.ca/
- Product: https://pitchproof.ca/product
- Pricing: https://pitchproof.ca/pricing
- Free prospect scan: https://pitchproof.ca/free-assessment
- Demo report: https://pitchproof.ca/sample-report
- Website audit software: https://pitchproof.ca/website-audit-software
- Resources: https://pitchproof.ca/resources
- Blog: https://pitchproof.ca/blog
- FAQ: https://pitchproof.ca/faq

Main product capabilities:
- Prospect website scanning
- Website health score out of 100
- Category score breakdowns
- Client-ready website opportunity reports
- PDF exports
- Saved and shared reports
- Lead Finder
- White-label reports on eligible plans
- Custom agency logo and brand colors on eligible plans

Pricing summary:
- Starter: $19.99 per month, 50 website scans, 3,000 Lead Finder results, PitchProof branding on reports
- Professional: $39.99 per month, 150 plan scans plus 50 bonus scans, unlimited Lead Finder results, white-label reports
- Growth: $79.99 per month, 500 website scans, unlimited Lead Finder results, white-label reports
- Enterprise: custom pricing

Important positioning:
PitchProof does not build websites automatically and does not guarantee sales, search rankings, or revenue. It helps agencies present clearer evidence and recommendations when selling website projects.
